description: Header file defining structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for handling text conversion, line ending normalization, and stream filtering in a version control system.

classes.name: delayed_checkout
classes.description: Structure representing a delayed checkout operation with state, filter list, and path list.

classes.name: checkout_metadata
classes.description: Structure holding reference name and object IDs for tree and blob.

classes.name: conv_attrs
classes.description: Structure containing conversion attributes, including driver, actions, encoding, and identification.

classes.name: stream_filter
classes.description: Opaque structure representing a stream filter for conversion operations.

methods.name: convert_attrs
methods.description: Function to set conversion attributes for a given path in the index.

methods.name: get_cached_convert_stats_ascii
methods.description: Retrieve cached ASCII conversion statistics for a given path.

methods.name: get_wt_convert_stats_ascii
methods.description: Retrieve working tree ASCII conversion statistics for a given path.

methods.name: get_convert_attr_ascii
methods.description: Get ASCII conversion attributes for a given path.

methods.name: convert_to_git
methods.description: Convert source content to Git format, returning 1 if destination buffer was used.

methods.name: convert_to_working_tree_ca
methods.description: Convert source content to working tree format using specified conversion attributes.

methods.name: async_convert_to_working_tree_ca
methods.description: Asynchronously convert source content to working tree format with specified attributes.

methods.name: async_query_available_blobs
methods.description: Query available blobs asynchronously.

methods.name: renormalize_buffer
methods.description: Renormalize line endings in a buffer.

methods.name: convert_to_git_filter_fd
methods.description: Convert content to Git format and write to file descriptor.

methods.name: would_convert_to_git
methods.description: Check if conversion to Git format would occur.

methods.name: would_convert_to_git_filter_fd
methods.description: Check if conversion to Git format is possible via file descriptor.

methods.name: init_checkout_metadata
methods.description: Initialize checkout metadata with reference name and object IDs.

methods.name: clone_checkout_metadata
methods.description: Copy checkout metadata and update blob object ID.

methods.name: reset_parsed_attributes
methods.description: Reset internal attribute parsing state.

methods.name: get_stream_filter
methods.description: Get a stream filter for a specific path and object ID.

methods.name: get_stream_filter_ca
methods.description: Get a stream filter based on conversion attributes and object ID.

methods.name: free_stream_filter
methods.description: Free a stream filter object.

methods.name: is_null_stream_filter
methods.description: Check if a stream filter is null.

methods.name: stream_filter
methods.description: Process input through a stream filter, producing output.

methods.name: classify_conv_attrs
methods.description: Classify conversion attributes into predefined categories.
